hha_blood.msg.hunted_start: Someone caught the scent of your blood ...
hha_blood.msg.hunted_end: You are no longer being hunted
hha_blood.tracker.title: Blood Tracker
hha_blood.tracker.pick: Whose blood do you want to hunt? (%ss)
item.hha_blood.blood_ingot.lore1: Crimson alloy for smithing Blood's Armor
item.hha_blood.blood_helmet.lore2: Blood Tracker [Ability 4]: pick a player within %s blocks - a vein of blood only you can see leads you to them
item.hha_blood.blood_helmet.lore3: Hunt lasts %ss, then %ss cooldown (also when ended early). The prey feels that it is hunted
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore2: Enduring Effects: all beneficial effects last x%s longer. Weaving always lasts %ss, Turtle Master (Resistance) %ss and its Slowness only lasts half as long
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore3: Set: Ability 1 Nihil - enemies within %s blocks float slowly into the air like after a shulker hit, are stunned and drained for %ss (lifesteal) (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore4: On the third beat a giant blood thorn bursts out of the ground under every enemy and impales it (%s damage), then a Blood Nova rolls out: %s damage and bleeding for everyone
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore1: Infection: %s%% chance on hit to make the target bleed (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore2: Blood Trail [Ability 2]: dive into blood - fully invisible for %ss, armour and held items included (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore3: Enemies within %s blocks take %s damage, bleed and get %ss of Slowness VI
item.hha_blood.blood_boots.lore2: Blood Rush: hitting a bleeding enemy grants Speed II for %ss
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore1: Hemorrhage: bleeding enemies take x%s damage from all hits
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore2: Right-click: Bloodsaws - 2 spinning saw blades that bounce off walls and ricochet from enemy to enemy, never back to you (%s dmg, %ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore3: Both saws hit together: Blood Fountain - bleed + %s dmg in %s blocks
item.hha_blood.blood_mace.lore2: Right-click: Blood Cyclone - the mace hovers spinning above the spot and shoots blood bolts at everything inside the marked circle of %s blocks (%s dmg + Infection, %ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_offering.lore1: Place it on the Sanguine Altar in the Heart Vault to challenge Prince Sanguin again
boss.hha_blood.prince.subtitle: The first bearer of the blood
boss.hha_blood.prince.awaken: Another heart that beats for me... come closer.
boss.hha_blood.prince.awaken_armor: You wear my skin. I will take it back - thread by thread.
boss.hha_blood.prince.reset: Run. The blood always finds you.
boss.hha_blood.reward.first: The Prince has fallen. His blood is yours.
boss.hha_blood.reward.again: The Prince falls again - but his blood has grown thin.
boss.hha_blood.altar.waiting: The Prince waits on his throne.
boss.hha_blood.altar.need: The altar demands a Blood Offering.
boss.hha_blood.cruorax.subtitle: What the blood made of him
boss.hha_blood.prince.transform: You think you have beaten me? Then behold what the blood has made of me!
boss.hha_blood.prince.phase3: My heart... beats for ALL of you!
boss.hha_blood.prince.heartbeat: Do you hear it? It beats!
